name: Button

parts.name: Button
parts.description: Accepts native button attributes and forwards its ref.
parts.note: Other native button props, including type, name, value, event handlers, and aria-* pass through. buttonVariants is exported for using the same style recipe in a custom composition.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual color treatment. Use inverse on a dark surface.

props.name: size
props.description: Padding and text size. unset leaves sizing to custom classes.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Uses the text-link treatment, with spacing and font size controlled by custom classes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Native disabled behavior and disabled styling.

accessibility: Set type="button" for in-form controls such as a dialog trigger; use type="submit" for form submission. The visible text or an appropriate label must name the action. Keep the supplied focus outline when extending styles. Use a link for navigation.
